name: Inspect AI
what_it_does: Framework for large-scale model evaluation with first-class support for agent and tool-use scenarios. Built by the UK AI Safety Institute; designed around the kinds of evaluations institutional safety teams actually need.
what_it_doesnt_do: Aimed at sophisticated evaluators; the on-ramp is steeper than a YAML-config tool. Limited turn-key reporting; you assemble what you need.
best_for: Teams running agentic evaluations with tool-use, multi-step reasoning
Safety-focused organizations matching public benchmark methodology
team_skill_required: Strong Python; evaluation-method literacy; LLM-internals familiarity.
